units.title: Symbolic logic
units.topics: 1. Concept of symbolic logic: nature, scope and applications. 2. Modern understanding of propositions: a) Simple and compound propositions b) Truth-functionally and non-truth-functionally compound propositions. 3. Prepositional variables, Prepositional constants, Logical constants and basic truth functions. 4. Symbolizing propositions using the above.

units.title: Decision Procedure
units.topics: 1. Concept of decision procedure. 2. Truth Table as Decision Procedure to identify propositional forms as a) Tautologous, b) Contradictory, c) Contingent

units.title: Inference
units.topics: Immediate inference and mediate inference: a) Conversion, b) Obversion, c) Opposition (Rules and deductions based on these types)

units.title: Deductive Proof
units.topics: 1. The relation between induction and deduction. 2. Concept of deductive proof. 3. Rules of Inference; The Rule of Replacement. 4. Direct proof.

subjects.title: Logic and Methodology of Science – I

units.title: Nature of science
units.topics: 1 Nature of science, pure and applied sciences. Commonsense and Science. 2 Theory and fact. 3 Science and Human Values.

units.title: Hypothesis
units.topics: 1 Nature of Hypothesis, Kinds of Hypothesis. 2 Conditions of a good hypothesis. 3 Confirmation of Hypothesis. 4 Falsifications.

units.title: Induction
units.topics: 1. Nature and origin of Induction. 2. Types of Induction: A) Simple enumeration B) Analogy. 3. Inductive leap. 4. Problem of induction and its solution.

units.title: Predicate logic
units.topics: 1. Introduction to predicate logic. 2. Difference between predicate logic and propositional logic. 3. Basic terminology: Constants, Variables, Functions, predicates. 4. Symbolization.

units.title: Set Theory
units.topics: 1. Nature of SET. 2. Methods of sets. 3. Types of Set.

units.title: Operations of Sets
units.topics: 1. Intersection Set. 2. Union Set. 3. Universal Set. 4. Complimentary Set. 5. Solve examples by using set operations.

subjects.title: Logic and Methodology of Science - II

units.title: Explanation
units.topics: 1 Nature of scientific explanation. 2 Distinction between scientific explanation and common-sense explanation. 3 Types of scientific explanation: 1. D.N. Model, 2. Functional, 3. Statistical, 4. Teleological, 5. Probabilistic.

units.title: Research Method in social sciences
units.topics: 1. Types of data collection (SPSS). 2. Survey, Case study, Field work. 3. Questionnaire, Interview, Observation (Merits, Demerits, Advantages, Disadvantages, significance, Limitations of all).

notes: SYBA Logic NEP 2020 syllabus for Semesters III & IV.
